cards.label: H3 Timeline
cards.description: THE video interface — multi-window film with SLA sparse attention, joint video+audio per window, auto-stitched into one mp4. The calls document IS the timeline.
principles: Describe MOTION and SOUND together — H3 generates both in one pass
Draft at 768x448x56f (~2.3s); produce at 1344x768x124f (~5.2s)
Length snaps to the 17k+5 frame grid at 24fps
For timelines: repeat the ambient soundscape verbatim in every window; add one new layer where the story needs it
Same seed across a shot's re-rolls keeps the world texture
SLA at sparsity 0.90 gives ~1.75x speedup with no quality loss — use it by default

cards.label: Image
cards.description: Text-to-image generation — the generate_image family card (build_txt2img); img2img + LanPaint inpaint ride the same card via input_image / lanpaint_mask
principles: prompt is required — an empty/whitespace prompt is rejected loud, never sampled with empty conditioning
Defaults are shape, not value: resolution/steps/cfg come from the model folder (defaults:/presets), merged at serve time
Sampler and scheduler option lists resolve from the ONE vocabulary (media.comfyui.sampler_vocab) — never hand-copied
A preset fills untouched fields; values you have set win
input_image + lanpaint_mask switches the builder to LanPaintKSampler
Mask prep (grow/feather/threshold/invert) and outpaint pads are applied host-side before the run — no silent param drops

cards.label: Image Edit
cards.description: Instruction-driven image editing — the edit_image family card (build_img2img_edit); up to three input images + reference list, mask-aware region editing, LanPaint tuning
principles: input_image is required — the edit is anchored on it (input_param: input_artifact, slots image1..image3)
Qwen-Image-Edit uses low CFG (flow-matching) — the Guidance Scale slider tops out at 10.0
A lanpaint_mask alongside input_image patches the model with the DiffSynth inpaint ControlNet
Region Mode controls how the mask is honored: auto / crop_stitch / full_frame
Mask prep (grow/feather/threshold/invert) uses the same host-side chain the Inpaint card uses
Iterate HERE, not in video — an edit costs seconds, a render minutes; name what changes, state the rest as unchanged

cards.label: 3D Generation
cards.description: Generate 3D meshes from images or text
principles: TRELLIS 2 input must be a square image (512x512 or 1024x1024)
Default quality to 'fine' for TRELLIS
Output is GLB format — compatible with Blender, Unity, web viewers

cards.label: Motion Generation
cards.description: Generate body motion from text prompts using Kimodo
principles: Kimodo generates skeletal animation from text descriptions
Output is GLB format with node-only hierarchy (no mesh)
Supports multiple skeleton types: SMPL-X 22, SOMA 30, G1 34
Default model is SOMA RP v1.1 (commercial use allowed)
Transition frames control blending between motion segments

cards.label: Body Studio
cards.description: Sculpt a character body shape using ANNY phenotype sliders — 11 identity dims + body/face detail morphs + community .target blendshapes
principles: ANNY is the only identity model exposed here (SOMA/MHR are in Pose Studio)
Default coeffs = neutral (all 0.5) — always pick a gender/age preset first
The mesh preview calls /poser/skin/mesh — debounced at 60ms during drag
Coeffs are order-sensitive: [gender, age, muscle, weight, height, proportions, cupsize, firmness, african, asian, caucasian]
local_changes are body-part morphs (e.g. upperarm-fat-incr) — set per slider
custom_targets are community MakeHuman .target blendshapes — Anny only
Saved characters persist to localStorage (v2 schema with customTargets)
